tool_schemas.name: create_document
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new document in the given collection (optionally nested under a parent document) and returns the created document record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs don’t match the required format, status is not one of the allowed values, or published_at is provided in an invalid date-time format; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace, collection, or parent document does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create documents in the target collection or workspace, and CONFLICT if the parent_document_id is not in the same collection as the new document or if a published document is created without a valid published_at when required by policy.

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace that will own the document.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to create the document in.

parent_document_id.description: Optional parent document ID to nest this document under.

published_at.description: Publish timestamp when creating a published document.

tool_schemas.name: delete_document
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified document and returns the deleted document (or a deletion confirmation for that document ID). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if document_id is missing or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if no document exists for the given ID. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the document, and CONFLICT if the document cannot be deleted due to its current state (for example, already deleted) or other integrity constraints enforced by the workspace.

document_id.description: ID of the document to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_document
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single document by document_id and returns the document record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if document_id is missing or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the document exists but you are not authorized to view it in its workspace/collection.

document_id.description: ID of the document to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_documents
tool_schemas.description: Lists documents in a collection, optionally filtered by status and/or parent_document_id, and returns a page of document records. Results are paged with limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor; when more results exist, the response includes a next cursor to fetch the next page, and sorting is controlled by sort and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, out-of-range limit, or invalid enum values; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the collection.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection whose documents will be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

parent_document_id.description: Filter to documents under a specific parent document.

tool_schemas.name: move_document
tool_schemas.description: Moves an existing document to the destination collection and optionally re-parents it under parent_document_id, returning the updated document record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the document, destination collection, or specified parent document does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to move the document or write to the destination collection, and CONFLICT if the move is not allowed (for example, the new parent is in a different collection than the destination, or the move would create an invalid hierarchy).

document_id.description: ID of the document to move.

parent_document_id.description: Optional new parent document ID in the destination location.

tool_schemas.name: search_documents
tool_schemas.description: Searches document titles and content within a workspace (optionally scoped to a collection) and returns a paged list of matching documents. Results are paged using limit (1–100) and an opaque cursor, and can be sorted by relevance or timestamp fields with order applied when supported. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enum values, out-of-range limit, or an empty/invalid query; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or provided collection) does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to search within the specified workspace/collection.

query.description: Full-text query to search titles and content.

collection_id.description: Optional collection ID to scope the search.

status.description: Filter search results by document status.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_document
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing document (title, text, status, and/or published_at) and returns the updated document record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if document_id is malformed, status is invalid, published_at is not a valid date-time, or the update would result in an invalid combination of fields; raises NOT_FOUND if the document does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to edit the document, and CONFLICT if the requested state transition is not allowed (for example, updating a deleted document or setting published status without a valid published_at when required).

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

text.description: Updated document body/content in plain text/markdown.

tool_schemas.name: create_collection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new collection in the specified workspace and returns the created collection record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs are malformed, status is not allowed, or provided fields (such as color/position) fail validation; raises NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create collections in the workspace, and CONFLICT if a collection with the same name is not allowed by workspace policy.

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace that will own the collection.

icon.description: Collection icon identifier (e.g., emoji or icon name).

tool_schemas.name: delete_collection
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified collection and returns the deleted collection (or a deletion confirmation for that collection ID). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to delete the collection, and CONFLICT if the collection cannot be deleted due to its current state or existing contents/integrity constraints enforced by the workspace.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get_collection
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single collection by collection_id and returns the collection record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is missing or malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the collection exists but you are not authorized to view it.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_collections
tool_schemas.description: Searches collections within the given workspace, optionally filtering by lifecycle status and a case-insensitive substring match on the collection name, and returns a sorted, paginated list of collection records. Results are limited by `limit`; when more results exist, a `cursor` is returned and can be passed back to fetch the next page. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if `workspace_id` is malformed or `limit/sort/order/status` are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the workspace, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring query applied to collection name.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update_collection
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing collection (such as name, description, color, icon, position, or status) and returns the updated collection record. Only the fields provided are changed; status changes are applied as requested (for example, archiving or deleting a collection). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if `collection_id` is malformed, no updatable fields are provided, or any field value is invalid; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to edit the collection; NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist (or is not visible to you); CONFLICT if the requested update is not allowed due to the collection’s current state (for example, attempting to modify a deleted collection); and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

collection_id.description: ID of the collection to update.

color.description: New color value for the collection (e.g., hex string).

icon.description: New icon identifier for the collection.

position.description: New ordering position for the collection within the workspace.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the collection.

metadata.name: Outline Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Outline-like knowledge base content: collections (folders/spaces) and documents (pages) that belong to collections and can be searched, moved, updated, or deleted. The main workflows are collection lifecycle management and document lifecycle management, including full-text search
